name: Awesome Indie

sources.title: Homepage — rebuilt daily indie launch board, ~10,375 makers, 15-25 products/day, community comments/makers feed; 'Add product' in nav

Pricing — 'Launching is free. Everything else is optional.' Free launch takes next queue slot (dofollow at 20 upvotes); paid: Skip the Line $9.99, Boost $29.99, Premium $49.99, Pro $49.99/yr, Sponsor $99.99/mo; Polar is merchant of record

conditions: Launching is genuinely free, but: free accounts are capped at 1 product lifetime (streaks raise this to 5), launches take the next queue slot rather than a chosen day, and a dofollow link is only earned at 20 upvotes
Account required — Google, GitHub, or X sign-in (no password flow)
requirements: Indie-product fit — board skews to solo founders, micro-SaaS, tools; AI moderation plus human review for paid tiers
For the dofollow link: 20 upvotes on launch day
Free account limits: 1 product lifetime, 3 upvotes/day
preparation: Product name, tagline, description, categories (148 available)
An OAuth account (Google/GitHub/X) — consider warming a login streak if you'll submit more than one product
A plan to drive ~20 upvotes on launch day if the dofollow link matters
workflow: Sign in via Google, GitHub, or X
Click 'Add product' / /submit and complete the product form
Free tier: accept the next queue slot; paid tiers let you pick a day
Product launches on its day, ranked purely by upvotes
Product page + maker profile are permanent; paid boosts (flame badge) last only the launch day
watchFor: The free tier's real cost is queue time — 'Skip the Line' ($9.99) is the only thing that buys an earlier day
Ranking is honest: upvotes only, paying never changes rank position (boosts are flame-labeled)
20-upvote dofollow threshold: daily traffic is small — top products get ~150 views, 0-5 votes; you may need to bring your own voters
Free account = 1 product lifetime — don't burn it on a half-finished listing
Streaks (daily visits) raise submission/upvote caps — a genuine engagement mechanic
Advertising content bans: no gambling, crypto, adult, get-rich-quick
countsAsLive: The product appears on awesomeindie.com's launch-day board with a public product page and maker profile
unknowns: Current queue depth for free launches (not shown publicly)
Whether sub-20-upvote links are nofollow or absent
